The root cause: the central transfers it lost at independence were worth 26% of its economy, and defence alone takes about 2.8% of GDP. It is the country's sixth major crisis since independence.
items.next: Creditors accept a 40% write-down in exchange for spending cuts. The economy shrinks 3.0% this year, and borrowing stays expensive for years.

items.title: Meghalaya's currency collapses
items.body: Foreign-exchange reserves fell to 0.7 months of imports, after a drought forced costly food imports. Fuel, fertiliser and medicine run short and prices jump. It is the country's third major crisis since independence.
items.next: An emergency loan restores about two and a half months of reserves but adds roughly 8% of GDP to its debt. The economy shrinks 0.3% this year.

items.title: Manipur is drawn into a border war
items.body: Armed groups based across the Myanmar border launch a sustained offensive. As a small independent country, Manipur has no larger army to call on; its defence budget was already about 2.8% of GDP. It is the country's sixth major crisis since independence.
items.next: Defence spending jumps, foreign investors pull out, and the economy shrinks 3.6% this year.

items.title: Telangana and Karnataka clash over the Krishna
items.body: In a drought year, Karnataka kept more of the Krishna for its own farms. Telangana depends on upstream rivers for about 30% of its water, and there is no longer a national court to referee. It is the country's second major crisis since independence.
items.next: Farmers block border crossings and crops fail in the downstream districts. The economy grows just 2.1% this year.

items.title: Sikkim's currency collapses
items.body: Foreign-exchange reserves fell to 0.0 months of imports, because it earns too little from exports to pay for what it imports. Fuel, fertiliser and medicine run short and prices jump. It is the country's sixth major crisis since independence.
items.next: An emergency loan restores about two and a half months of reserves but adds roughly 8% of GDP to its debt. The economy grows just 1.8% this year.

It is the country's fifth major crisis since independence.
items.next: Creditors accept a 40% write-down in exchange for spending cuts. The economy grows just 0.6% this year, and borrowing stays expensive for years.

items.title: Uttar Pradesh and Jharkhand form a customs union
items.body: After 20 years of queues at the new border posts, the two drop tariffs and inspections. Jharkhand gets a steady supply of grain from Uttar Pradesh's farms.
items.next: Trade between them recovers toward what it was inside India, though the rest of the old single market stays split.
